scripts.build:wasm: cd ../i18n-wasm && wasm-pack build --target bundler --release && cp -r pkg/* ../i18n-node/wasm/
scripts.build:node: npx napi build --platform --release && CARGO=cargo-xwin npx napi build --platform --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.build:all: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:node && npm run build:frameworks
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm run build:all && npm pack
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm run build:all && npm pack
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm run build:all && npm pack
